issue_context.title: LE Audio: Move board files for nRF5340 Audio development kit upstream
issue_context.body:
We want to, and have been given approval to, copy the board files for the Nordic Semiconductor nRF5340 LE Audio development kit to Zephyr upstream, so that the board can more easily be used in that code base.

Remaining question to be resolved: Board files only, or also drivers?
comments:
> Remaining question to be resolved: Board files only, or also drivers?

If the drivers are possible to upstream, it would allow for developers to use e.g. the jack, which is a very nice feature of the board.

Also, the SD file system access would be quite valuable.

Would the binary controller still be residing in the nrf repo?

As linked, this will be resolved by #49720.
The SD card is accessible using standard upstream drivers.
Using the Jack/analog input is dependent on third party drivers with dependencies. There is no plan to upstream these at present time, so we encourage users to go to https://github.com/nrfconnect/sdk-nrf for full support.

The binary controller will be in the NCS repo, yes.

review_comments: This was added to the standard nrf5340dk_nrf5340 in commit 86a1cc7 to fix a possible compilation error.
This can be changed, but this function is supposed to only return 0.

Apart from the core_config, this code is common for all of the nrf5340 SoC Boards.

Not a comment on your review, but a note for the maintainers of the nRF boards that this should be improved IMO.
This code contains the security configuration of the network core, and it would be nice to have a single implementation of this.
This is copied from the ordinary nrf5340dk_nrf5340
